purpose: Teach: カキコ/小中学校/新米/百姓/貧乏人/里山/駿/ぎょ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがパソコン通信のカキコを楽しまれた
lines.en: Your father, when he was younger — he used to enjoy posting on computer bulletin boards, Gran.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Eyes distant, reaching back. Gentle pace, letting each image settle. Voice fades slightly at the end, as if he's still seeing it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、小中学校時代の同窓会を毎年開かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and your father — he held his school reunions every year, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm agreement, gentle correction. Bringing him back gently with her own memory. Tender but present, the kind of thing she's said a hundred times before.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが「新米社員時代の失敗」を語られた
lines.en: Your father used to talk about those early days at work — all the mistakes he made as a fresh recruit, Gran.
lines.style: Still distant, but with a thread of tenderness now. Slower pace. The memory carrying some weight. Trailing softly, like he's not quite finished looking at it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、百姓出身、つまり農家のご先祖を誇りに思ってらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your father — he was so proud of that heritage, wasn't he? Coming from farming people, from the land itself, dear?
lines.style: Affirming, almost proud herself. Voice steady and sure. Bringing dignity into the room with her words. Not asking, knowing — the confidence of decades together.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは「貧乏人の家から出ても努力次第」と仰った
lines.en: He used to say it — that no matter where you come from, if you work hard enough, you can rise above it. That's what your father believed, Gran.
lines.style: Voice grows firmer, conviction settling in. Opening word carries weight. Pace remains steady. Slight emphasis on the belief itself, as if passing it forward.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、里山の杉を植林されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And he planted those cedars in the foothills himself, didn't he? When he was young and strong, dear?
lines.style: Her voice carries quiet pride and practicality. The image of him doing it — of something that lasted, something real. Warm and certain.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがお孫の駿さんを膝に乗せられた
lines.en: I remember him holding your grandson Shun on his lap — little Shun, so small in his hands. That was something, wasn't it, Gran.
lines.style: Voice softens considerably. Opens with tenderness. Pace slows for the image of the child. Slight breath before 'on his lap' — the vulnerability of remembering that closeness.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、戦時中に「ぎょっとされた」事もあったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: There was that time during the war, wasn't there — when something shocked him terribly. You remember that, don't you, dear?
lines.style: Gentle but direct. Her voice carries the weight of wartime truth without dwelling. Not asking for sympathy, just naming what happened. Close, intimate — only for him.
